parameters.query: select id, slug, name, status, created_at from public.tenants order by slug;

insert into public.keywords (tenant_id, query, normalized_query, intent, source)
values (
  (select id from public.tenants where slug = 'ita-bag-lab'),
  'custom ita bag', 'custom ita bag', 'commercial', 'n8n-demo'
)
on conflict do nothing
returning id, query, intent, source;

select query, normalized_query, intent, source, created_at
from public.keywords
where source = 'n8n-demo'
order by created_at desc
limit 5;
